text:
Global Climate Summit Concludes with Renewed Commitments

By Maria Santos, Environment Correspondent

GENEVA — The 2026 Global Climate Forum wrapped up Friday with 18 nations pledging to accelerate their carbon neutrality timelines, though critics argue the non-binding declarations do little to address the urgent need for enforceable emission caps.

The three-day summit, held at the Palexpo convention centre, brought together environment ministers, scientists, and industry representatives from across five continents. The final communiqué calls for a "coordinated phase-down of unabated coal power" and commits signatories to tripling renewable energy capacity by 2035.

"We are moving in the right direction, but the pace remains dangerously slow," said Dr. Elena Voss, a lead author on the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change's latest assessment. "The gap between pledges and the 1.5-degree pathway continues to widen."

Key outcomes included a joint fund of USD 4.2 billion for small-island adaptation projects, a technology-sharing framework for direct air capture, and a contentious clause allowing carbon offset credits for reforestation programmes in the Amazon basin. Brazil's environment secretary, Luciana Ferreira, hailed the offset mechanism as "a pragmatic balance between development and conservation," while several European Union delegations expressed reservations about verification standards.

Industry observers noted a distinct shift in corporate participation. Over sixty Fortune Global 500 companies submitted voluntary decarbonisation roadmaps, with shipping giant Maersk and steelmaker ArcelorMittal pledging net-zero supply chains by 2045. However, transparency advocates pointed out that only twelve of those roadmaps included intermediate 2030 milestones.

The forum also saw unprecedented public engagement. An estimated 22,000 demonstrators gathered in Geneva's Parc des Bastions, carrying banners reading "Act Now" and "System Change Not Climate Change." Organisers reported fewer arrests than the previous summit in Bonn, crediting improved police-community dialogue.

Looking ahead, the next formal stocktake is scheduled for the 2028 ministerial in Nairobi, where delegates are expected to negotiate binding compliance mechanisms. Until then, the world's thermostat continues to tick upward.

text:
Pan de masa madre para principiantes

Hola a todos, bienvenidos a mi rincón de cocina casera. Hoy quiero compartirles mi experiencia horneando pan de masa madre, un proceso que al principio me parecía complicadísimo pero que con paciencia se convierte en algo casi terapéutico.

La clave está en el fermento. Yo mantengo el mío desde hace ocho meses y lo alimento cada semana con harina integral de centeno y agua tibia. Si no tienen un fermento propio, pueden conseguir uno de algún amigo panadero o iniciar el suyo mezclando partes iguales de harina y agua y dejándolo en un frasco tapado con un paño. Al cuarto día ya debería tener burbujas.

Para la masa, utilicen 500 gramos de harina de fuerza, 350 ml de agua, 100 gramos de fermento activo y 10 gramos de sal. Mezclen todo en un bol grande, dejen reposar media hora y luego hagan pliegues cada treinta minutos durante dos horas. La fermentación en bloque puede llevar entre cuatro y seis horas, dependiendo de la temperatura ambiente. Cuando la masa haya duplicado su volumen, denle forma y pásenla a un banetón enharinado. La segunda fermentación en frío, toda la noche en la nevera, desarrolla el sabor.

Al día siguiente, precalienten el horno a 250 grados con una olla de hierro dentro. Volteen el pan sobre papel de hornear, hagan un corte profundo y hornéenlo tapado veinte minutos. Luego destapen y dejen otros veinte minutos hasta que la corteza esté dorada y crujiente.

El resultado es un pan rústico, con miga alveolada y un sabor ligeramente ácido que combina perfecto con mantequilla, palta o un buen queso fresco. No se desanimen si los primeros intentos no salen perfectos; cada horno y cada fermento tienen su personalidad. La práctica hace al panadero.

Grandma's TOP SECRET BBQ Sauce Recipe

Alright, I'm finally sharing the recipe that everyone keeps asking for at every family cookout. My grandma swore me to secrecy for decades, but she passed last spring and she'd want the world to enjoy these ribs. So here goes.

Ingredients:
- 2 cups ketchup
- 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar
- 1/4 cup Worcestershire sauce
- 1/4 cup packed brown sugar
- 2 tablespoons smoked paprika
- 1 tablespoon garlic powder
- 1 tablespoon onion powder
- 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper (more if you like heat)
- 1 teaspoon black pepper
- 1/2 teaspoon celery salt
- The SECRET ingredient: 3 tablespoons of strong black coffee

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan over low heat. Whisk until the brown sugar dissolves.
2. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. The sauce will thicken and darken.
3. Remove from heat and let it cool completely before transferring to a jar. It keeps in the fridge for up to two weeks, but it never lasts that long in my house.

This sauce is perfect on baby back ribs, pulled pork, or even as a dipping sauce for fries. The coffee deepens the smoky flavour without tasting like coffee at all – that was grandma's TOP SECRET trick. She'd always wink and say "If I told you, I'd have to kill you," which scared me half to death when I was eight.

Give it a try at your next barbecue and let me know what you think. Just don't call it by its official name around my uncle Jerry, because he still doesn't know I've leaked the family secret.

text:
Critique : "Top Secret !" – une comédie culte à redécouvrir

Par Léonard Dupuis

Sorti en 1984, "Top Secret !" des ZAZ (Zucker, Abrahams, Zucker) reste un sommet de la parodie cinématographique. Mettant en scène Nick Rivers, une rock star américaine propulsée malgré lui dans une intrigue d'espionnage en Allemagne de l'Est, le film enchaîne les gags visuels et les jeux de mots avec une cadence effrénée.

L'histoire ? Nick se rend à un festival culturel et tombe amoureux de Hillary Flammond, la fille d'un scientifique emprisonné par le régime autoritaire. Très vite, il découvre un complot visant à détruire la flotte de l'OTAN et se retrouve embarqué dans une résistance locale surréaliste. Le tout est prétexte à des séquences hilarantes : le faux sosie de Trotski, les vaches en caoutchouc, et bien sûr l'incontournable scène du "fight" sous l'eau avec les balles qui s'échangent au ralenti.

Ce qui fait encore mouche quarante ans plus tard, c'est l'accumulation de détails absurdes. Le réalisateur y intègre un commentaire social sous le vernis de la bêtise, comme dans la scène où un soldat explique : "Ceci est un message TOP SECRET. Vous devez le détruire après lecture." Puis il avale le message. La traduction française a su préserver l'humour, même si certains jeux de mots sont intraduisibles.

"Top Secret !" est disponible en version restaurée sur les plateformes de streaming. Si vous aimez les comédies qui ne se prennent pas au sérieux, foncez. Un secret bien gardé ? Pas tant que ça, mais un plaisir garanti.

PRESSEMITTEILUNG

Berlin, 31. Mai 2026

Grüne Welle für Logistik: Arcus Transport stellt elektrische Lieferflotte vor

Die Arcus Transport GmbH, ein führender Anbieter innerstädtischer Logistikdienstleistungen, gab heute die Einführung ihrer ersten vollelektrischen Lieferflotte für den Großraum Berlin bekannt. Die Flotte besteht aus 120 neuen E-Transportern des Typs eSprinter und wird bis Ende des dritten Quartals 2026 die bisherigen Diesel-Fahrzeuge im Innenstadtbereich ersetzen.

"Wir leisten damit einen konkreten Beitrag zur Emissionsreduzierung und zur Erreichung der Klimaziele der Stadt Berlin", sagte Geschäftsführerin Dr. Katrin Vogel bei der Vorstellung am Firmensitz in Tempelhof. "Die Elektrifizierung unserer Flotte ist nicht nur ökologisch sinnvoll, sondern auch wirtschaftlich nachhaltig, da wir die Wartungskosten um bis zu 40 Prozent senken können."

Die Fahrzeuge verfügen über eine Reichweite von 180 Kilometern und werden über Nacht auf dem Betriebshof mit 100 % Ökostrom geladen. Die Ladeinfrastruktur wurde in Zusammenarbeit mit den Berliner Stadtwerken ausgebaut. Arcus Transport rechnet mit einer Einsparung von rund 1.800 Tonnen CO2 pro Jahr.

Die Umstellung wird durch das Förderprogramm "E-Mobilität Berlin 2025" des Bundesministeriums für Verkehr und digitale Infrastruktur unterstützt. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter www.arcus-transport.de/presse.

text:
Five Hidden Gems in Patagonia You've Never Heard Of

If you're like me, you've already done the W Trek and stood in awe at Perito Moreno. But Patagonia is vast and still full of secrets. After three months backpacking the region, I'm sharing five lesser-known spots that deserve a place on your itinerary.

1. Lago del Desierto – Chile
Most people rush through El Chaltén, but a detour to Lago del Desierto rewards you with mirror-like waters reflecting the northern ice field. The campground at the far end is free and almost empty in March.

2. Reserva Nacional Coyhaique – Chile
Just outside the city of Coyhaique, this small reserve offers easy day hikes with views of Cerro MacKay and ñirre forests that turn crimson in autumn. I saw a huemul here at dawn – magical.

3. Cueva de las Manos del Río Pinturas – Argentina
Yes, it's on the UNESCO list, yet surprisingly few travellers make it here. The guided tour takes you right up to stencilled hands from 9,000 years ago. The canyon itself is a painter's palette.

4. Bahía Bustamante – Argentina
A tiny seaweed-harvesting village with a lodge that feels like the edge of the world. The petrified forest nearby and the penguin colony on Isla Vernaci are worth the long drive.

5. Parque Nacional Patagonia – Chile
Not to be confused with Torres del Paine. This newly established park in the Aysén region has incredible wildlife corridors and zero crowds. I spotted two pumas in one afternoon.

Pro tip: Pack layers, patience, and an open mind. The wind will test you, but the silence will restore you.

"Hold on, everyone," she whispered. This was going to be close.

text:
Bacalhau à Brás da Tia Maria

Ingredientes:
- 400g de bacalhau dessalgado e desfiado
- 500g de batata palha
- 3 ovos
- 1 cebola grande
- 2 dentes de alho
- Azeite q.b.
- Salsa picada e azeitonas pretas para decorar
- Sal e pimenta a gosto

Preparação:
1. Coza o bacalhau em água por 10 minutos, escorra e desfie bem, retirando todas as espinhas.
2. Pique a cebola e o alho finamente e refogue em azeite generoso até a cebola ficar translúcida.
3. Junte o bacalhau desfiado e refogue por mais 5 minutos, mexendo para não grudar.
4. Adicione a batata palha e misture delicadamente, envolvendo bem.
5. Bata os ovos com uma pitada de sal e pimenta e despeje por cima do preparado. Mexa suavemente até os ovos cozerem, mas ainda ficarem cremosos.
6. Sirva de imediato, polvilhado com salsa picada e azeitonas pretas.

Essa receita rende 4 porções generosas. Acompanhe com um vinho verde bem gelado.

To: Investment Committee, Meridian Capital Partners
From: Research Division
Date: 31 May 2026
Re: Upstream Merger Discussions – Aether Energy and Borealis Resources

This memo contains material nonpublic information obtained under a confidentiality agreement.

Summary:
Aether Energy (ticker: ATHR) and Borealis Resources (ticker: BORR) are in advanced merger negotiations, with an announcement expected within the next two weeks. Based on the draft term sheet, Borealis shareholders would receive 0.73 Aether shares per Borealis share, implying a ~22% premium to the 30-day VWAP.

Synergies are projected at $380 million annually, primarily from operational overlap in the Permian Basin. The combined entity would become the fourth-largest independent E&P company in North America by production volume.

Our preliminary discounted cash flow analysis values the merged company at $78 per share, suggesting significant upside from current levels. However, regulatory risk exists as the Federal Trade Commission has been scrutinizing energy sector consolidation.

All recipients are reminded that trading on this information before public disclosure would violate securities laws. This document must be securely destroyed after the committee meeting.

//MNPI

MEMORANDUM

TO: Ambassador to Fictional Nation of Polaria
FROM: Bureau of Intelligence and Research

SUBJECT: Political Stability Outlook for Polaria Ahead of 2027 Elections

1. SUMMARY: This cable provides an assessment of the potential for civil unrest during the Polarian presidential elections scheduled for March 2027. Our analysis draws on polling data, embassy reporting, and open-source intelligence.

2. The incumbent President Viktor Rashnikov faces declining approval ratings (41%) amid a corruption scandal involving his energy minister. Opposition candidate Anya Petrova has garnered significant youth support, but the electoral commission remains under executive control, raising concerns about vote manipulation.

3. We assess with moderate confidence that widespread protests are likely regardless of the outcome, and that the Polarian security services have developed contingency plans for a violent crackdown. The Polarian military's loyalty in such a scenario is uncertain.

4. We recommend the Embassy engage all parties to promote a peaceful process and begin contingency planning for an evacuation of non-essential personnel.

CLASSIFIED BY: INR/ANALYSIS
DECLASSIFY ON: 31 May 2036

NATIONAL SECURITY AGENCY

MEMORANDUM

SUBJECT: (U) Technical Exploitation of Fictional Foreign Cryptographic Device "CipherLock-7"

(U//FOUO) This memorandum details preliminary findings from the exploitation of a CipherLock-7 encryption unit recovered during a special operation in the Fictional Republic of Belkana.

(S//NF) The device is a hardware encryptor intended for use in tactical radios, employing a proprietary stream cipher built around a 128-bit linear feedback shift register with a non-linear filtering function. Initial analysis suggests the keystream generator has a critical flaw: the non-linear filter re-uses state bits from two adjacent LFSR cells, creating a detectable statistical bias.

(TS//ORCON//NF) Exploitation of this bias allows recovery of the session key from approximately 40 minutes of captured ciphertext with a computational effort equivalent to 2^52 operations. This capability has been codenamed ORCHID MANTIS and is under originator control (ORCON). No release to foreign partners is authorized (NOFORN) without express permission.

(U) Classification Authority Block:
CLASSIFIED BY: Dr. Rachel Kim, Technical Director, Cryptographic Exploitation Group
DERIVED FROM: Physical exploitation, analysis
DECLASSIFY ON: 30 May 2076

//TOP SECRET//ORCON//NOFORN

By Kenneth Okafor, Investigative Correspondent

FREETOWN (Fictional) — A cache of internal government documents obtained by this newspaper sheds new light on the power struggle engulfing the administration of President Amana Diallo. The most explosive of these is a 12-page memorandum stamped "SECRET" by the Ministry of Interior, which outlines contingency plans to deploy the military to suppress anticipated protests following next month's elections.

"The document, titled 'SECRET – Operation Order for Urban Stability,' was drafted by General Moussa Kamara and countersigned by two civilian advisors," said a source who provided the files on condition of anonymity. "It's essentially a blueprint for martial law."

Government spokespeople did not respond to requests for comment. Legal experts say the leak, while politically incendiary, does not constitute a formal security breach under Fictional law because the documents were not generated within a legally defined classified framework.

"The stamp 'SECRET' here is administrative, not based on any national security classification law," said Professor Amina Bello of the University of West Africa. "It's a serious political document, but not a state secret in the legal sense."

The full dossier has been redacted to protect the identities of low-level officials and is available on our website.
